track: CLIMB (fermer la machine a tsoins, dans le bassin)

ranked.name: tsoin-store
ranked.what: tsoin.put/get/query -> store content-adresse addr=fnv1a64(gen)^fnv1a64(residu), dedup+requete. Remplace l id sequentiel in-memory.

ranked.name: diff
ranked.what: diff.compare -> XOR-delta general + residu minimal (run-length) + surprise en bits.

ranked.name: generator
ranked.what: gen.expand {gen,residu} -> reel : l inverse universel (xerbion a l envers). Rend la machine reversible.

ranked.name: clock-coherence
ranked.what: clock.now {t,coherence} : t = co-occurrence des topics (pas wall-clock). Loi cahier p.42.

ranked.name: player
ranked.what: player.play -> DEROULE une sequence de tsoins dans le temps (scrub/pause/boucle).

ranked.name: block-fold
ranked.what: replie un amas de blocs MC en cubions (extrait fold::grid3d de carte vers un bion general).

ranked.name: tsoin-kind
ranked.what: classe chaque tsoin REEL vs MACHINE (garde-fou anti-derive). Signal Jose #596.

ranked.name: purge
ranked.what: tsoin de purge: grave l etat encombre AVANT reset (reversible). Signal Jose #597/#606.

ranked.name: resynth
ranked.what: recompose un son depuis son spectre (inverse de spectre, erreur via diff).

ranked.name: io-port

ranked.name: qubion
